questions: Did you come to the clinic today because you noticed shaking in your arms?
Does the shaking happen when you try to hold your arms out straight?
Has this shaking been getting worse over the past few weeks?
Do you feel any stiffness or slowness in your movements?
Have you noticed any tremors in your hands when you are resting?
Does the shaking stop when you relax your arms completely?
Have you experienced any recent changes in your handwriting?
Do you have any difficulty with balance or walking?
Have you noticed any trembling when you are not moving your arms at all?
Is there a family history of similar shaking or movement disorders?
Have you started any new medications recently?
Do you feel more tired than usual?
Have you noticed any changes in your sense of smell?
Do you experience any numbness or tingling in your hands or arms?
Have you had any recent head injuries?
Do you consume excessive amounts of caffeine or stimulants?
Is there any history of thyroid problems in your family?
Have you been experiencing significant stress or anxiety lately?
Do you notice the shaking more when your hands are under emotional or physical stress?
Have you been told you have any nerve or muscle conditions in the past?
